role: The GUI scale math: from the real framebuffer size and gameSettings.guiScale it derives the scaled GUI width/height every 2D screen and the HUD draw with.
scope_reason: The container screens, the death screen, the pause screen and the HUD are pixel-gated against the oracle (out/java/render scenes), so the scale derivation is part of the renderer's contract.

members.name: scaledWidthD
members.note: not stored natively; only the ceiling survives

members.name: ScaledResolution
members.note: the scale loop and the ceil divisions are ported; the func_152349_b (unicode) even-scale adjustment is not

notes: gui_screen_layout's loop `while (scale < gui_scale && width/(scale+1) >= 320 && height/(scale+1) >= 240)` matches the Java loop; verified by reading both, not by a targeted test. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): the unicode-font branch is off in the pinned options. Formerly listed as missing: The constructor's func_152349_b branch (unicode font: drop one scale step when the factor is odd and not 1) has no native counterpart; gui_screen_layout runs the plain loop only. The guiScale=0 means 1000 default is the caller's job natively.
